<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">GeoCoordinatesUpdate</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Represents geographical coordinates in 3D space.
 Unlike <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocoordinates" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoCoordinates</code></a>, its members can be undefined, allowing for APIs
 that update only the specified parts of geo coordinates.</div>
</li>
</ul>

<a id="&lt;init&gt;(java.lang.Double,java.lang.Double)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>GeoCoordinatesUpdate</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;GeoCoordinatesUpdate&#8203;(@Nullable
                            java.lang.Double&nbsp;latitude,
                            @Nullable
                            java.lang.Double&nbsp;longitude)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Constructs a GeoCoordinatesUpdate from the provided latitude and
 longitude values.
 Corrects values of latitude and longitude if they exceed the ranges.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>latitude</code> - <p>Latitude in degrees. Positive value means Northern hemisphere.
     If the value is out of range of [-90.0, 90.0] it's clamped to that range.
     NaN value is converted to <code>null</code>.</dd>
<dd><code>longitude</code> - <p>Longitude in degrees. Positive value means Eastern hemisphere.
     If the value is out of range of [-180.0, 180.0] it's replaced with a value
     within the range, representing effectively the same meridian.
     NaN value is converted to <code>null</code>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(java.lang.Double,java.lang.Double,java.lang.Double)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>GeoCoordinatesUpdate</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;GeoCoordinatesUpdate&#8203;(@Nullable
                            java.lang.Double&nbsp;latitude,
                            @Nullable
                            java.lang.Double&nbsp;longitude,
                            @Nullable
                            java.lang.Double&nbsp;altitude)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Constructs a GeoCoordinatesUpdate from the provided latitude, longitude
 and alt values.
 Corrects values of latitude and longitude if they exceed the ranges.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>latitude</code> - <p>Latitude in degrees. Positive value means Northern hemisphere.
     If the value is out of range of [-90.0, 90.0] it's clamped to that range.
     NaN value is converted to <code>null</code>.</dd>
<dd><code>longitude</code> - <p>Longitude in degrees. Positive value means Eastern hemisphere.
     If the value is out of range of [-180.0, 180.0] it's replaced with a value
     within the range, representing effectively the same meridian.
     NaN value is converted to <code>null</code>.</dd>
<dd><code>altitude</code> - <p>Altitude in meters. NaN value is converted to <code>null</code>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
